title: Training vs Light and Darkness Ritual
summary: Pure Light and Darkness Ritual (Black Chaos) wants Griffoh as a full tribute for a Level 8 ritual, then Magician of Dark Chaos or Soldier of Light and Darkness plus Mind Shuffle. The ritual loop recycles the spell from GY; Mind Shuffle searches and swaps bosses on your turn.
winConditions: Stop the first ritual (Griffoh tribute or Pre-Prep package)
Remove Mind Shuffle before they bounce-and-summon through your negation
Win while they have no ritual spell in GY to recycle
keyCardsRespect: Griffoh — full tribute for the Level 8 ritual and sets Mind Shuffle
Light and Darkness Ritual — summon plus GY recycle
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos — protection and banish
Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness — on-summon banish
Mind Shuffle — search and mid-chain boss swap
Black Chaos — discard to plant Mind Shuffle, then banish two
keyCardsNegate: Pre-Preparation of Rites / Manju / Celtic Mystic searches
The ritual spell on the first summon
Mind Shuffle search or the bounce-summon
Griffoh discard if it would set Mind Shuffle for free

tips.title: This build is Pure, not Azamina
tips.body: The training bot does not play Azamina or Branded. Expect a ritual loop and Mind Shuffle, not White Forest or Fallen of Albaz lines.

tips.title: GY ritual spell is the engine
tips.body: Once Light and Darkness Ritual hits GY it adds itself back with another engine card. Banish it or the ritual monster they want to loop.

tips.title: Targeting is the out
tips.body: Both ritual bosses ignore opponent effects unless they target. Targeted removal, Super Poly, and kaijus beat 'unaffected' better than non-targeting board wipes.

handtrapGuidance: Ash Pre-Prep, Manju, or Celtic Mystic when it completes the ritual package.
Imperm the first ritual boss if you must stop the on-summon banish.
Called by Griffoh if they try to use it as the entire tribute from GY later.
Droll after the first search if Mind Shuffle would still add.
commonMistakes: Non-targeting the ritual boss and watching it ignore the effect
Leaving Mind Shuffle on field through your own combo
Assuming this bot has Azamina or Branded extenders
